## Emerald 2.2.2-dev.5

This prerelease improves the sizing of numeric Settings fields and application
update controls so values and action labels remain fully readable.

### Settings controls

- **Font size**, **Column width**, and **Line spacing** now use a wider,
  consistent editing field with enough room for their largest displayed value.
- The fields continue to account for translated unit suffixes such as pixels
  and percentages.

### Update controls

- Update prompts now size every action from its rendered, translated label.
- Longer actions such as **Install & Restart** no longer appear clipped, while
  shorter **Download**, **Open**, **Later**, and **Cancel** actions retain a
  comfortable minimum size.
- The download progress dialog applies the same sizing to its Cancel action.

### Testing notes

- Open **Settings → Editor** and confirm the three numeric fields show their
  complete values and units without crowding.
- Check for a Development update and confirm every prompt and download action
  displays its complete label on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
- From `2.2.2-dev.4`, select the **Development** channel and restart Emerald;
  the automatic startup check should offer this `dev.5` build.

### Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux (x86-64) | `Emerald-x86_64.AppImage` | `chmod +x` and run |
| Linux (ARM64) | `Emerald-aarch64.AppImage` | requires glibc 2.39 or newer |
| macOS (universal) | `Emerald-macOS.dmg` | drag to Applications; first launch **right-click → Open → Open** |
| Windows | `Emerald-win64-setup.exe` | installer with Markdown **Open with** registration |
| Windows portable | `Emerald-win64.zip` | extract and run `emerald.exe` |
